CREATE TABLE `pc_memory_entry_versions` (
  `scope_id` varchar(256) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `family` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `memory_artifact_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `entry_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `entry_version_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `version` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `previous_version_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `kind` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `text` mediumtext NOT NULL,
  `source_refs` mediumblob NOT NULL,
  `artifact_refs` mediumblob NOT NULL,
  `entry_content_hash` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `created_in_revision` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`scope_id`, `memory_artifact_id`, `entry_version_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `pc_memory_entry_versions_OBFK_1793244384596795` FOREIGN KEY (`scope_id`, `family`, `memory_artifact_id`, `created_in_revision`) REFERENCES `test`.`pc_artifacts`(`scope_id`, `family`, `artifact_id`, `revision`) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT ,
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_pc_memory_entry_versions_logical_version` (`scope_id`, `memory_artifact_id`, `entry_id`, `version`) BLOCK_SIZE 16384 LOCAL,
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_pc_memory_entry_versions_identity` (`scope_id`, `memory_artifact_id`, `entry_id`, `entry_version_id`) BLOCK_SIZE 16384 LOCAL,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_pc_memory_entry_versions_version_positive` CHECK ((`version` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_pc_memory_entry_versions_revision_positive` CHECK ((`created_in_revision` > 0))
) ORGANIZATION INDEX DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8mb4 ROW_FORMAT = DYNAMIC COMPRESSION = 'zstd_1.3.8' REPLICA_NUM = 1 BLOCK_SIZE = 16384 USE_BLOOM_FILTER = FALSE ENABLE_MACRO_BLOCK_BLOOM_FILTER = FALSE TABLET_SIZE = 134217728 PCTFREE = 0
